label: stand 1
title: Stand still
instruction: Stand still, facing the camera, your arms down.

label: gallop 1
title: Gallop
instruction: Squat as you would to make your horse GALLOP, as fast as you comfortably can. Do not jump.

label: jump 1
title: Jump
instruction: Stand, and JUMP with both feet each time you see JUMP! Land softly, then stand again.
